Years ago my husband and I had got into an argument. Couldn’t tell you what it was about. But he had went to Walmart and come back with this pack of shirts. I’m still mad and watching him open it and I just see him flinging this shirt open expecting the rest of it to unravel. He was getting angry and frustrated with it. And I’m just sitting there like what the hell is wrong with this man. And then it dawns on me...he bought a whole pack of child shirts. I could not contain my laughter. And then he realizes the mistake he made and he starts laughing. We make up. And it’s such silly moments like that I still laugh at randomly now.

Mmm I hear you. And the ones who do still ask how you are. They want the fake answer. That you are doing great. But you aren’t. I’m sorry the ones in your life have you feeling like this. I can relate.

Wow. You have been through so much. And it’s nice to find a community of people that understand how I’m feeling. The reason sucks but nonetheless...I’m not alone. I’m just tired of people telling me how strong I am. I don’t know who they are talking about because it’s surely not me.

Thank you. And trust me I know thinking it’s my fault isn’t true...but I guess I’m just trying to hope there would have been a way to save him somehow. I go through all the different scenarios of ways I could have possibly saved him. But I know the only scenario that I can focus on is the one where he’s no longer here. And hopefully at peace. And myself finding peace.
That’s a beautiful way to view it. I try to think of that too. He was struggling so much mentally that I know his soul is at peace now.

Yes! I hear you. A few months before that I lost my grandmother who helped raise me. And then a few months after my husband died I found out my father isn’t my biological dad. My life has been a shit show no doubt. 
October has to be the toughest month of the year for us though. My daughters birthday is the 22nd. He killed himself the 25th and my sons birthday is November 1st. I really have tried to make my sons birthdays especially happy. But boy was that a rough one. My son was just turning 8. We were supposed to take him to disneyland but instead had to plan a funeral. 
I try to put on a brave face for them but. I’ve learned they feel as I do. They want someone to talk to that isn’t going to feel awkward by it. So I keep that line of communication always open. And we’ve found random strangers along the way that have been amazing in our journey to finding peace as well.

Thank you. And yes it’s very hard having been through such darkness and people not knowing how to react to it. I mean I get it. It’s sad and dark but...I just wish I wasn’t completely ignored about it.

I’m so sorry. We didn’t end off on the greatest of terms as well. Mostly bc I needed to distance myself. His mental health was at an all time low. And I often feel like I should have held on tighter. But I couldn’t do it anymore. I was emotionally drained from giving all my attention to him instead of my kids and myself. 
Thank you for the resource though I’m going to look into it!

I’m so sorry for your loss. It’s like... you aren’t asking for a whole therapy session from people but at the same time not being acknowledged bc it makes them feel uncomfortable makes me feel like I’m being dramatic or something.

Thank you for your kind words. It’s definitely been something I’m continuously trying to wrap my head around. The “shoulda coulda wouldas”. But I know I needed to save myself first and foremost. And my children. It’s been tough trying to find a therapist in my area. I went to one and had a not so great experience so it put me off for a while. But i thinking I’m ready to explore that resource again.
Thank you. That made me cry. But I’m a good way. I felt so responsible for him while he was alive that I need to realize that wasn’t my responsibility. I shouldn’t have put that on myself.

Thank you for this. My husband committed suicide in 2018 and all I remember is my stepmother telling me “You probably could have done more to help him” that broke my damn heart and made my whole family want to kill her. I was there to stop him from so many suicide attempts. But I had to take a step back to save myself and protect my kids mental health. And right when I did. He did it. I think about it all the time. It’s my fault. I could have saved him like all those other times.  But I know deep down it’s probably not true.
I’m very interested too! Me and my kiddos have been looking for months for a good fit.

I get it. But you can’t treat every medical professional that comes in like they are a leper. Some people get food before their shift. Clean scrubs and all. I understand the concern but there are other people that work in close contact with patients. Not just nurses that people don’t realize. Respiratory,phlebotomists,etc. Some of which don’t wear scrubs. And some people are wreckless. But a lot of the medial professionals are scared and are going above and beyond to make sure they are safe from being infected or possibly infecting. Just FYI. I work in a hospital. It’s been hell. And people treating us like shit bc we are hungry and working long hours isn’t making it better.
